items.t: Horn works only some of the time (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 96V-088. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Ignition switch housing cracks (recall)
items.note: Free under recalls 00V-317 and 06V-403. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belts may not lock (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 97V-115. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tie rod end seals fail (recall)
items.job: Replace outer tie rod ends and align
items.note: Price is for both sides. Recalls 99V-248 and 00V-414 cover affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Oil sludge in the 1.8T engine
items.job: Drop oil pan, clean pickup screen and change oil
items.note: If the engine was damaged from low oil pressure, a replacement engine costs much more.

items.t: Ignition coil failures
items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs
items.note: Price is for all four coils and plugs. Replacing one coil costs less.

items.t: Crankcase ventilation (PCV) valve and hoses fail
items.job: Replace PCV valve and breather hoses

items.t: Multitronic CVT failure on front-drive models
items.job: Replace Multitronic CVT with a rebuilt unit
items.note: Some cars are fixed with a control module repair or fluid service, which costs much less.

items.t: Fuel pump can quit and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recalls 06V-017 and 07V-375. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Xenon headlights dim over time (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall 05V-096 for affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Camshaft lobe and cam follower wear
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump cam follower
items.note: If the cam lobe is worn, replacing the camshaft and fuel pump costs much more.

items.t: Air bag control unit can corrode (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-376. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace pistons and rings with updated parts
items.note: A past class settlement covered some cars. Ask an Audi dealer whether any coverage remains.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the chain jumped and damaged the valves.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing

items.t: Electric after-run coolant pump can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 18V-229. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger air bag may switch off (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-874. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear trailing arm nut can crack (recall)
items.note: Free under recalls 21V-295 and 22V-034. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belts may unlock too early (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-606. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rearview camera shows a blank screen (recall)
items.note: Free under recalls 21V-825, 22V-742 and 22V-806. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine can stall from a faulty engine computer (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-368. Check the VIN first.
